title: Add an offline reward scorer for recorded native traces
summary: locomotion.reward_scorer rebuilds the training reward's telemetry from evaluation control traces and scores the current reward and any candidate beside a motionless counterfactual under the same commands. It measures velocity at the root-link origin, as training does, and rejects a trace when that reconstruction disagrees with the recorded critic observation. Non-foot contact force and the first control's previous target are not recorded; the report declares both gaps.
next: Score the paired PPO and optimizer replay traces and publish the report as evidence before citing any reward ranking.
reason: An offline analysis tool and its tests change no measured result, roadmap marker, gate or training reward.
